fee_notes: Royalty is 4.0% of Net Sales, paid weekly. Advertising Fund contribution is 3.0% of Net Sales for traditional units (may increase up to 4%, no more than 1% per year); Non-Traditional Units within a Host Facility pay 1.0%. Local Advertising Requirement is 1.0% of Net Sales (may increase up to 1.5%). Transfer fee is 25% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee (or $0/$2,000 under limited conditions for early entity transfers). Interest on late rent is 5% per month; interest on other late payments is lesser of 18% per annum or max legal rate. Management fee is 8% of Net Sales if Perkins manages the franchise. Liquidated damages upon breach/termination are $300,000 or three years of estimated royalties and marketing contributions, whichever is greater. Technology/helpdesk fee currently $850/year (billed monthly), expected to increase to $1,500/year; total technology costs currently range $349–$500/month inclusive of helpdesk. Central Billing Fee not currently in effect but may be up to 10% of amounts due to supplier. Non-Participation/Non-Reporting Fee: $100 (1st month), $200 (2nd month), $300 (3rd and each subsequent month).
